summary.scope: Eight final static snapshots, one per episode; repeated voxel-events across episodes are not unique global cells.

gap20mm.limitation: Samples do not establish clearance of an unsampled continuous volume or a robot path.

gap30mm.limitation: Samples do not establish clearance of an unsampled continuous volume or a robot path.

reference_scope.centers: Exact analytic primitive or validated convex-mesh center membership; closed boundaries with a 1e-12 local-coordinate tolerance.
reference_scope.whole_cell_occupied: All eight actual voxel corners lie inside one convex reference; sufficient interior, rather than exact coverage by a union.
reference_scope.whole_cell_clear: No overlap with conservative inverse-cell or plane outer bounds; only this verified-clear stratum is scored as definite excess.
reference_scope.omissions: Otherwise fixture-free ground-contact centers at or below 15 mm, and centers inside actual exposure mesh world bounds, are omitted. All fixture-occupied centers are retained.
reference_scope.surface: Final-frame selected, retained native instance-labeled external depth endpoints. Event counts differ from unique cells; out-of-bounds events are explicit.
reference_scope.visual_collision: Authored primitive physical and visual geometry coincide; the wedge collision convex hull matches its authored convex mesh. Mapper mesh AABBs are approximate and do not define exact physical truth.

limitations: UNKNOWN is expected and does not establish clearance.
Center false-FREE and false-OCCUPIED in partial-volume cells do not prove that the entire voxel is physically misclassified.
Zero excess in the conservative clear stratum does not establish accuracy of every possible-overlap cell.
The 12 mm object can have visible pixels and zero selected rays; coverage of obstacles near voxel resolution is not guaranteed.
This is the static baseline before the V4 temporal hit-handling correction; no runtime integration or planning is evaluated.
